name: For Christmas I Want a Dragon
aka: What Color Do You Want Your Dragon
look: A four-panel comic in a 2x2 grid. A girl with a brown bob sits with Santa and excitedly asks for a dragon. Santa tells her to be realistic. She makes a new wish in a blank bubble. Santa, now wearing glasses and holding a quill and scroll, asks what color dragon she wants.
text: FOR CHRISTMAS I WANT A DRAGON!
WHAT COLOR DO YOU WANT YOUR DRAGON
use: The girl's realistic wish in the third panel is so unlikely that Santa decides a magical dragon is the easier request. Used for goals more impossible than fantasy, like affordable rent or code that works the first time.
slots: the girl's realistic wish, in the blank bubble of panel 3
her reply in the small bubble of panel 4 (optional)
examples: I want a phone battery that lasts all day
I want my code to work on the first try
describe: girl asks santa for a dragon and he says be realistic
kid on santa's lap wants a dragon comic
santa asks what color dragon after hearing the real wish
four panel christmas comic with a girl and santa claus
realistic wish is harder than getting a dragon
